verifier: blind Claude agent re-implementation from the brief only; comparison computed by compare_independent.py (agent verification, not human)
ambiguities: Filter (season>=2006, season_type in {2,3}, completed, both scores present) is applied before taking the first row per game_id; files are concatenated in ascending season-file order so 'first' means first in that order.
date = game_date column (already a calendar date; equals the America/New_York date of game_date_time for all rows).

Line-score strings are numpy-repr lists without commas between dicts; parsed by regex per {...} block. A 'period' key whose value is None/NaN is treated as absent (position used instead). A dict with a missing/None/NaN 'value' counts as that period being absent (first occurrence still claims the period).
W state is carried across seasons with no reset (team history from 2006 on); computed with the recursion W_i = x_i + r_*W_{i-1}, mathematically equal to the stated sum.
Team-games on the same date as the row (including the row's own game and any same-day doubleheader) are excluded from the pre-state; state is taken from the last team-game with date strictly earlier.
Wt/W1 and Wm/W1 are missing when the team has no prior team-game; fhp_exp_h1_total_pre and mrm_m_hat_pre are then missing.
When lg_r is missing (S-1 has no defined r, i.e. seasons <= 2023 since line scores only exist from 2023), value_X is missing (NaN propagates), so all fhp columns are missing for 2013-2023.
H is the mean of home_score - away_score over all filtered games (season types 2 and 3) of S-1 with neutral_site not true; missing H (only for 2006 rows) makes mrm_m_hat_pre missing.

Reference rows for mrm bins are all team-games (both perspectives of a game, season types 2 and 3) of seasons max(2007,S-10)..S-1 with mrm_m_hat_pre present; blow, ot and win use the row's own margin/ot. Bins absent from the reference give missing values for the row.
mrm_comp_sd_pre / mrm_blow_sd_pre use ddof=1; means/SDs over the blow=0 / blow=1 subsets are computed only when the bin has >= 20 reference rows overall.
Output rows are sorted by (game_id, team); team ids written as integers.
